project.description: Build an 8-bit host protocol control and stream shell as a complete SR2FPGA Verilog RTL project. This is component topology t9_host_protocol_shell, difficulty tier T9. Use axi_lite_write_ctrl and axi_lite_read_ctrl feeding control_reg_bank, then sample_stream_adapter and irq_status. The design must implement this black-box behavior: AXI-lite-style writes configure sample registers and start streaming; one AXI-stream-style payload is emitted, status can be read back, and irq remains asserted until cleared. Keep rtl/top.v as the integration wrapper and keep each reusable component in a separate RTL file. Preserve these interface contracts: top.s_axi_awvalid -> axi_lite_write_ctrl.awvalid; top.s_axi_awaddr -> axi_lite_write_ctrl.awaddr; top.s_axi_wvalid -> axi_lite_write_ctrl.wvalid; top.s_axi_wdata -> axi_lite_write_ctrl.wdata; top.s_axi_wstrb -> axi_lite_write_ctrl.wstrb; axi_lite_write_ctrl.awready -> top.s_axi_awready; axi_lite_write_ctrl.wready -> top.s_axi_wready; axi_lite_write_ctrl.bvalid -> top.s_axi_bvalid; top.s_axi_bready -> axi_lite_write_ctrl.bready; axi_lite_write_ctrl.write_valid -> control_reg_bank.write_valid; axi_lite_write_ctrl.write_addr -> control_reg_bank.write_addr; axi_lite_write_ctrl.write_data -> control_reg_bank.write_data; top.s_axi_arvalid -> axi_lite_read_ctrl.arvalid; top.s_axi_araddr -> axi_lite_read_ctrl.araddr; axi_lite_read_ctrl.arready -> top.s_axi_arready; axi_lite_read_ctrl.read_valid -> control_reg_bank.read_valid; axi_lite_read_ctrl.read_addr -> control_reg_bank.read_addr; control_reg_bank.read_data -> top.s_axi_rdata; axi_lite_read_ctrl.rvalid -> top.s_axi_rvalid; top.s_axi_rready -> axi_lite_read_ctrl.rready; control_reg_bank.start_pulse -> sample_stream_adapter.start; control_reg_bank.sample0 -> sample_stream_adapter.sample0; control_reg_bank.sample1 -> sample_stream_adapter.sample1; sample_stream_adapter.tvalid -> top.m_axis_tvalid; top.m_axis_tready -> sample_stream_adapter.tready; sample_stream_adapter.tdata -> top.m_axis_tdata; sample_stream_adapter.tlast -> top.m_axis_tlast; sample_stream_adapter.stream_done -> control_reg_bank.stream_done; control_reg_bank.irq_state -> irq_status.irq_in; irq_status.irq_out -> top.irq. Include system_his.json, manifest.json, timing constraints, predicted QoR, and a bounded self-checking testbench that prints TEST_PASS only on success or TEST_FAIL on failure.
